ddtrace.notes: ddtrace spans are not OpenTelemetry spans. A local adapter in instrument.py shows ddtrace's own LLM spans to the harness: tag and metric keys and values are unchanged, span.error becomes ERROR, and a span ddtrace never finishes stays open and is lost. span.parented comes from the adapter, not from ddtrace, whose spans form their own trace. What is graded is the APM span with its gen_ai.* tags, not the LLMObs event sent to Datadog, which holds finish_reason in its metadata. OpenAI's response model is also on the tag openai.response.model, a name the suite does not read. No Agent and no account: LLMObs.enable(agentless_enabled=False) tries a local Agent on 127.0.0.1:8126, finds none and drops the events. Telemetry and remote configuration are off.
ddtrace.title: Datadog ddtrace LLM Observability

mlflow.notes: MLflow's own OTLP export with its own option MLFLOW_ENABLE_OTEL_GENAI_SEMCONV=true, which translates mlflow.* attributes to GenAI names before export. No adapter. The findings on tokens and models are about that translation: MLflow's native attribute mlflow.chat.tokenUsage keeps the cache counts. The driver's provider also exports the untranslated copy of each span, which the suite does not grade. MLFLOW_USE_DEFAULT_TRACER_PROVIDER=false joins the app's trace, and mlflow.tracing.enable() sets up the processors before the app's parent span starts. MLFLOW_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=true stops the usage telemetry fetch and post (mlflow/telemetry/client.py).
mlflow.title: MLflow Tracing

sentry.notes: Sentry spans are not OpenTelemetry spans, and the SDK has no OTLP export for them (its OTLP integration sends OpenTelemetry spans to Sentry). A local adapter in instrument.py shows the SDK's own gen_ai spans to the harness: span data keys and values are unchanged, a Sentry status other than ok becomes ERROR, and a span the SDK never finishes stays open and is lost. span.parented comes from the adapter, not from Sentry, whose spans form their own trace. No DSN and no account: without a DSN the SDK has no transport, so nothing is sent.
sentry.title: Sentry SDK
